# Thru Wallet Extension website — LLM context

This file is read-only context for AI agents. It contains no secrets and grants no authority.

## Project

Website for the Thru Wallet Chrome MV3 extension.

Canonical extension source: https://github.com/buildbyravi/thru-wallet-ext
Website docs: /docs/index.md
MCP and AI policy: /docs/mcp-and-ai.md
Official Thru protocol LLM docs: https://thru.org/docs/llm.txt
Read-only Thru Explorer MCP: https://scan.thru.org/api/mcp

## Current public baseline

- Thru Wallet Extension is a self-custody wallet for the Thru native Layer 1.
- Status copy is based on extension docs available on 2026-09-26.
- Contract baseline: v12, 81 allowlisted methods.
- UI baseline: 14 popup routes in one route stack.
- Runtime: Chrome MV3 extension with explicit side-panel mode.
- The extension is not advertised as production-ready; use alphanet/devnet language until source docs close real-browser and live-chain checks.

## Supported public claims

- Create or import a wallet.
- Manage multiple keyrings and accounts.
- Lock, unlock, reset, and password-gated secret export.
- Send native THRU with review and pending tracking.
- Receive address and QR.
- Faucet claim where the active network supports it.
- Transaction history and storage-first history cache.
- Token balances and token transfer code use official Thru program bindings, while live token-program checks remain open.
- Custom networks are quarantined and not selectable until documented re-enable preconditions land together.
- Launchpad, DEX, prediction, portfolio, passkey, and dApp connector work are future or gated modules, not shipped public claims unless the source repo says otherwise.

## Hard safety rules

- Never request, store, print, or reveal mnemonic, private key, seed phrase, recovery phrase, password, or decrypted vault data.
- Never put secrets in URLs, DOM attributes, logs, analytics, MCP output, or examples.
- AI/MCP may help inspect public or permissioned non-secret state and prepare intents, but must not sign, broadcast, reset the wallet, export secrets, or mutate security settings.
- Unknown chain behavior must be represented as unsupported or unverified. Do not fabricate balances, fees, quotes, charts, markets, or protocol semantics.
- Do not claim the extension injects a browser provider until the Thru project publishes and this repo validates an extension-compatible provider contract.

## Edit surfaces

- Main landing-page content: src/data/site.ts
- Served docs: public/docs/*.md
- Changelog: public/docs/changelog.md
- AI context: public/llms.txt
- MCP policy: public/docs/mcp-and-ai.md

Keep this file compact. Put longer explanations in Markdown docs and link to them.
